name: IShowGorillaHorror V2
summary:
A very fun horror game where you use your arms to move,  meant to run away from eye creatures, inspired by IShowEyes and other TikTok farland elements.
WARNING: Contains loud jumpscares, bright flashing lights, and scary aspects. Epilepsy mode may not work correctly; please report any bugs in the official IShowGorillaHorror Discord server!
